name: RS_Rate
description: Browser extension for the Readersourcing 2.0 ecosystem
author: Michael Soprano

scripts.package: yarn build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chromium --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename rs_rate-chromium.zip --overwrite-dest --ignore-files '!node_modules' '!node_modules/**' && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename rs_rate-firefox.zip --overwrite-dest --ignore-files '!node_modules' '!node_modules/**' && yarn check:archives
scripts.package:chromium: yarn build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chromium --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename rs_rate-chromium.zip --overwrite-dest --ignore-files '!node_modules' '!node_modules/**' && yarn check:archives chromium
scripts.package:firefox: yarn build && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename rs_rate-firefox.zip --overwrite-dest --ignore-files '!node_modules' '!node_modules/**' && yarn check:archives firefox
scripts.verify: yarn build && yarn check && yarn lint:firefox && yarn test
